en.text:
Kills charge up an <solar/>Improvised Explosive (three Tripmines duct-taped together). 

Kills grant charges based on the method used: 
• Weapons: <pve 1 /> <pvp [2] /> charge
• Ignition and Scorch: <pve 3 /> <pvp [4] /> charges
• Abilities: 4 charges
• Super: 6 charges

At 6 charges, replaces your Grenade Ability with a thrown explosive that travels with reduced velocity. Explosive causes an <solar/>Ignition when detonated, and incurs a 6 second cooldown upon throw.

Shooting the explosive increases its damage by <pve 50% /> <pvp [5%] />, ignition radius by ?%, and releases 9 homing submunitions from its center. Sticking the explosive directly onto an enemy and then shooting it adds an additional damage instance equal to <pve 67% /> <pvp [?] /> of the aboved buffed detonation.

If not shot, the explosive detonates on its own after 3 seconds.

Gunpowder Gamble counts both as an <solar/>Ignition and a Grenade Ability. It triggers, and is buffed by, both grenade and ignition-specific effects.
